method: Unchanged BlockFence, BlockRailBase/Rail/BlockRail, BlockMobSpawner and BlockTorch on a world double: a sparse cell map over an optional stone floor (y < 0); setBlockMetadataWithNotify stores the metadata, setBlockToAir removes the cell, doTileDrops is off so no item entity spawns, isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered is false and isBlockNormalCubeDefault reads Block.isNormalCube. Per-block masks are bit m = metadata m. Rail placement is ItemBlock order: setBlock(rail, 0) then onBlockAdded. Spawner XP comes from a subclass that only overrides the dropXpOnBlockBreak sink, with World.rand = new Random(seed). No game classes patched
